featured_reviews.review_text:
I had joined the Zumba class with Sagar Sir in January and paid the full fees. After a few sessions, the classes suddenly stopped. When I raised the issue, Sagar himself said he would return my money — even though I didn’t ask him to. But now, he is not responding to my calls and hasn’t refunded the amount.

On top of that, the studio space was very unhygienic — hair strands were all over the floor, and when I pointed it out, he simply said “No, it’s clean, you just lie down and do exercise.” It felt careless and unprofessional.

He also doesn’t seem to remember why he had taken leave or why the classes were discontinued. Very disappointing experience — both in terms of hygiene and accountability. I wouldn’t recommend this class based on my experience

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a dedicated Bharatanatyam dancer and feel truly grateful to be part of this dance institution. My journey here has been one of discipline, growth, and deep connection with Indian classical art. The classes are well-structured, systematic, and rooted in tradition, while also encouraging confidence and stage presence.

Our guru/sir is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and inspiring. His teaching goes beyond just steps—he emphasizes abhinaya, rhythm, expressions, theory, and the cultural essence of Bharatanatyam. Every student is guided personally, with attention to detail and encouragement to improve continuously. The learning environment is positive, respectful, and motivating.

Through this dance class, I have grown not only as a dancer but also as an individual, gaining dedication, grace, and confidence. I highly recommend this institution to anyone who wishes to learn Bharatanatyam with sincerity, discipline, and strong guidance under an experienced teacher. 🌸
